milestones.title: v0.20
milestones.description: Challenge Program step 2: Library and Education challenges.

epics.title: Seeker Relationship Management (SRM)
epics.goal: Help every person take their next natural step, with a real person who knows them. Admins only.

features.title: Event type and audience on every event
Journey levels (New, Seeker L2–L4, Initiate) and Journey tab
Person page: timeline, mentor, notes, milestones
Follow-ups list with ready-to-edit messages
Event insight (opened → Going → came, first-timers, came back)
Interests, language and contact preferences; unsubscribe link in every email
Question log (no open questions on the teachings)
Audience suggestions for events
Roadmap report shared by seekers with their mentor (contents TBD)
Seva roster

epics.title: Copilot Challenge Program
epics.goal: Gentle goals with a finish line that make meditation, attendance and study a habit.

features.title: 21-Day Foundation and 21-Day Advance (replaces the 42-day challenge)
Choose your first challenge at Copilot sign-up
Admin challenge form: minute choices, grow-to, next step, offered at sign-up
Library in the admin site: articles, books (link look-up, chapters), videos
Education challenges: daily quote, weekly articles, book chapters, weekly videos (with catch-up)
Reading card in Insights and points for reading/watching
Book Club: read a book together with weekly discussion

epics.title: Development and release process
epics.goal: One repository, tests with a report on every build, test environment, approvals, release notes and What's new.

features.title: One repository with local run for any developer (Windows and Mac)
Unit, API and browser tests with a report per build
Release script: build → test → prod, with backups and rollback
Test environment: test.sosmn.org, test-admin.sosmn.org, test database
What's new page and version in every footer

epics.title: Ready for more centers
epics.goal: Run another center by copying the repo or from one app, using centers/<id>.json.

features.title: Center settings file (centers/mpls.json) used by the build
Remove remaining hard-coded Minneapolis text from the apps
